title: The Saffron Thief's Death at Willow Green
intro_text: the night was thick with the scent of ripe fruit and the soft clink of porcelain cups, while a hush hung over the town square like mist on dewy grass.

locations.name: Little Cafe
locations.description: A cozy nook where small tables are set under an awning, and warm golden light bathes the space in a gentle glow.

locations.name: Quiet Residence
locations.description: A quaint little house nestled on a peaceful lane, its windows like sleepy eyes peering into the night.

locations.name: Willow Green Park
locations.description: A verdant expanse where the air is thick with the scent of wildflowers and the rustle of leaves beneath footsteps.

methods.text: Method 1: tricked them into a dangerous meeting place at the park at night.
Method 2: sabotaged their cart so it rolled downhill on Willow Green Lane.
Method 3: sent them down the wrong road at night, where they slipped and fell into a hidden pond.
Method 4: poisoned their evening tea with a deadly spice from the herb garden.

motives.text: Motive 1: inherit a small but useful sum of money.
Motive 2: keep a stolen land deed hidden forever.
Motive 3: punish them for spreading a rumour around town.
Motive 4: end a feud that had been simmering for years.
